prompt_en: An individual photographic interpretation of Flintlock Fantasy: a woman shown using the supplied portrait as an appearance reference, in a scene where flintlock craft and working magic coexist. Her facial proportions follow the supplied portrait, and her short dark bob with wispy bangs follows the supplied portrait. She sits at a deep oak workbench in a small powderhouse atelier, absorbed in the instant a mechanical spark wakes a bottled weather charm. A walnut-stocked flintlock pistol lies horizontally in a padded wooden testing cradle across the foreground, with its iron lock facing the viewer and its barrel pointing toward the right edge. Its curved walnut grip sits below one short barrel; the external flint-gripping lock is visibly attached beside that barrel. The exposed cock grips a chipped flint in its jaws; the frizzen has flipped forward above the shallow pan, and a few amber sparks hang beside the steel. Immediately beside this lock, a narrow glass bottle held in a brass ring contains a tiny luminous blue storm cloud, with one miniature fork of lightning visibly touching its inner glass. The bottle and lock share the same plane of focus. Her right hand rests open on the bench just behind a released brass test lever; her left hand lightly steadies the bottle's supporting brass ring, fingers clear of the lock. She wears an ink-blue linen work coat and a plain cream shirt, the collar relaxed from long concentration. Her parted lips and attentive eyes carry quiet warmth as she leans toward the little storm. Photograph from the opposite side of the workbench at her eye height, a horizontal waist-up frame with both forearms, the full pistol and the bottle legible. Cool window light from the left shapes her face; the bottle adds a contained blue reflection to her fingertips and the pan. Weathered plaster, a closed powder tin and a rack of hand tools recede softly behind her. Tactile photographic realism, restrained color, sufficient depth for the face and the apparatus, a close human encounter with meticulous dangerous craft.
